d678b3f5f2.q: How do UK custodians compare to American custodians for setting up accounts and moving client assets?
d678b3f5f2.a: The biggest difference is how badly UK custodians perform in comparison to Americans when setting up accounts. Moving money from one account to another to pull clients' assets together is a dream in the US, whereas the UK is just so far behind on that front.
d678b3f5f2.e: 105. Cross Border, Cross Country: 1,000 Miles of RV Life as a British Expat in America

bc01f8aa8f.q: What are the key differences between taking a driving test in the UK versus New Hampshire?
bc01f8aa8f.a: The US test is far more relaxed than the UK. In New Hampshire, after going up one road, doing a three-point turn, and leaving it in reverse—which would be an automatic failure in the UK—the examiner simply said 'you've been driving for years, haven't you?' and passed him after only three minutes in the car.

688029e1f6.q: What is the Lincoln Undercroft at the Lincoln Memorial and when did it open?
688029e1f6.a: The Lincoln Undercroft opened in 2024 on the 250th anniversary and is located underneath the Lincoln Memorial. It shows the original plans for the memorial, including submissions for alternative designs such as a pyramid, and takes about 15 minutes to tour while exploring Lincoln's life.

246a4c2317.q: What were the average nightly and monthly costs for RV campgrounds in New Hampshire versus near Washington DC?
246a4c2317.a: In August in New Hampshire, with a longer-stay average campground including gas and electricity, it was about fifty dollars a night, totaling just over fifteen hundred dollars for the month. In September near DC, it was more like eighty dollars a night, resulting in approximately 2,400 dollars for the month.

40d21bc782.q: What was the RV failure that occurred at a Harvest Host vineyard near Philadelphia?
40d21bc782.a: While driving their one-ton RV into a shady area at a Harvest Host on the outskirts of Philadelphia on a hot day, the wheel started to sink into wet ground that had retained dew from the morning. They had to place stabilizer pads underneath to get traction to reverse out, and learned not to stay on grass anymore.

2e9fe64934.q: How many miles had James Beck and his family covered by the time of this episode?
2e9fe64934.a: James and his family had covered just over a thousand miles traveling from New Hampshire through Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Maryland, Virginia, and North Carolina, currently based in Greenville, South Carolina, heading toward Austin for the Grand Prix.
